name: hcportal_updateFcmToken
description: Stores the browser's refreshed FCM push token on the calling portal device row and stamps LastLogin; Version and BuildNumber are written only on a browser row (IsMobile = 0) — a phone row keeps the app's own values (2026-09-29). The same token string is then retired (FcmToken NULL, FcmTokenDeleted stamped) from every OTHER device row, as hcapp_setFcmTokens does, so one browser never holds two live rows. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @fcmToken as the token param string; acts only on the caller's own device.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @fcmToken as the paramString.

parameters.name: fcmToken
parameters.description: New FCM push notification token to store for the device. Narrowed from NVARCHAR(1000) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(500) in HC6 to match the table column and ValidatePortalAuth paramString width.

parameters.name: buildNumber
parameters.description: Portal build number; written only when the device row is a browser (IsMobile = 0).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Portal version; written only when the device row is a browser (IsMobile = 0).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, NULL deviceId (unreachable in practice — auth fails first), or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned after successfully updating the device record.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device for @deviceId: FcmToken, LastLogin, and Version/BuildNumber when IsMobile = 0
UPDATE HC.Device SET FcmToken = NULL, FcmTokenDeleted = SYSUTCDATETIME() on every other row holding the same token (when @fcmToken is not NULL)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 110-113: CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row, so a failed token refresh (which silently stops portal pushes) leaves no server record.
